```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()
```

# 01 Load packages

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)    ## administración datos
library(readxl)       ## carga de archivos excel
library(purrr)        ## iteraciones
```


```{r}
## Functions used from "purrr" package

# map()     -> takes a list of vectors as input -> allows operations to be performed on each element of the list -> returns a list as the result

# map2()    -> takes 2 lists of vectors as input -> allows operations between 2 lists (simultaneously, like a zipper) -> returns a list with the result of the operation on both lists

# pwalk()   -> takes a list of vectors as input (like a df -> list of columns) -> matches names with function arguments to perform actions on each row of the list -> does not return a result (new list) -> but rather a side effect/modification

# walk()    -> takes 1 list of vectors as input -> performs operations like map(), but not to calculate results, rather to perform actions in a loop (side effects) -> does not return a result (new list)

# iwalk()   -> takes 1 list of vectors as input -> accesses the list and iterates, but considers the name/index of the element being iterated over, allowing the inclusion of dynamic names (hence i(index)) -> does not return a result (new list)

# map_dbl() -> takes 1 list as input -> allows operations to be performed on each element of the list -> returns a numeric vector (double) as the result
```

# 02 Input Model Parameters

### 02.1 Load general paramenters

The next chunk execute in one step the specified code lines in the subtittle. You can run the lines for understand the process. Also you can modified as you wish for your particular Markov Trace Model.

```{r}
#| label: load in one step excel archive with params model as a list in Global environment
#| eval: true

## excel file name
excel_inputs_files <- "Inputs_model.xlsx"

## excel sheets names in a R list of list
sheets_names <- excel_sheets(excel_inputs_files)

## load excel sheet as unique list
params_list_all <- sheets_names %>%      ## list with all excel sheets (within each list its params used in the MarkovModel)
  purrr::set_names() %>% 
  purrr::map(function(sheet){
    read_excel(path  = excel_inputs_files,
               sheet = sheet,
               col_types = "text") })
View(params_list_all)
```

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| label: set as environment object elements in params_list_all


##---------- 1. Load general inputs ----------##
df_general <- params_list_all[["GENERAL_INPUTS"]] %>% 
  type.convert(as.is = T)                             # convert from text to a numeric

df_general %>%
  purrr::pwalk(function(name, value, ...) {
    assign(name, value, envir = .GlobalEnv) })

## elements: age, max.age, cycle_length, n_sim, age_start, brun_in

# Calculates
n.t <- max.age - age_start ## numero de ciclos
rm(df_general)

## age = 30
## age_start = 18


##----------  2. Strategy names ----------##
v.names.str <- params_list_all[["STRATEGY_NAMES"]] %>%
  pull(1) 

n.str <- length(v.names.str)

## elements: No prevention, UreaAire, Antígenofecal, EDA, PSEDA, Serología


##---------- 3. state names ----------##
v.n <- params_list_all[["STATE_NAMES"]] %>%
  pull(1)

n.s <- length(v.n)  ## 39 stages, from Normalhpn/p, 4clinicalf and Dead



##---------- 4. Load RTI modeled vector ----------##
df_rti <- params_list_all[["RTI_MODEL"]]  

rti_vector  <- purrr::map_dbl(df_rti$value, 
                 ~eval(parse(text = .x )))

## elements: modeled RTI at each age. Not used anymore.


##---------- 5. Load as elements in environment:
##                   Transition probs
##                   Strt probs 
##                   Cost 
##                   Utilities 
##                   Acceptability 
##                   Erradication inputs ----------##


##---------- 5.1 quite excluded sheets ----------##
excluded_sheets <- c("GENERAL_INPUTS",     ## already loaded
                     "STRATEGY_NAMES",     ## already loaded
                     "STATE_NAMES",        ## already loaded
                     "RTI_MODEL",          ## already loaded
                     
                     ## probability die vectors calculated 
                     ## and assign in chunks below (see 02.4.3)
                     "PROB_DIE",           
                     "PROB_DIE_30_39",     
                     "PROB_DIE_31_100",    
                     "PROB_DIE_30_44",     
                     "PROB_DIE_41_100",    
                     "PROB_DIE_46_100", 
                     "PROBS_TRANSITION_ORG",
                     "PROBS_TRANSITION (2)",
                     "Hoja1"
                     )    


##---------- 5.2 Filter the master list for keep the necessary params sheets ----------##

## set in a list the sheets with params to load
l_params <- params_list_all[setdiff(names(params_list_all), 
                                    excluded_sheets)]

## purrr within the list
purrr::iwalk(l_params, 
             
      function(df_sheet, 
               name_sheet) {
  
  ## check required columns exists 
  if (all(c("name",                            ## name of the object in the environment
            "value",                           ## value of the object in the environment
            "usage") %in% names(df_sheet))) {  ## indicate if the row in the list is necessary to include
    
    
    ## usage filter for used params to be loaded
    df_sheet_filter <- df_sheet %>% 
            filter(tolower(usage) == "yes")
    
    
    ## walk each row in the sheet
    purrr::pwalk(df_sheet_filter, 
          function(name,
                   value,
                   time_efect = NA, ...) {     ## indicate if that probability change in time
      
            
      ## convert text in cells sheets into real (within R) value
      final_value <- eval(parse(text = value))
      
      
      ## RTI transformation
      if(stringr::str_starts(name_sheet, "PROBS")){
        
        ## if time_efect !NA and time_efect == "yes", then, apply RTI transformation, otherwise repeat the value for all cycles (n.t)
        if(!is.na(time_efect) && tolower(trimws(time_efect)) == "yes"){
         
          
           # save basal value for calibration
           assign(paste0(name, "_base"),
                  final_value,
                  envir = .GlobalEnv)
          
          
           basal_rate <- -log(1 - final_value) 
           
           ajust_rate <- basal_rate * rti_vector   
         
           final_value <- 1 - exp(-ajust_rate)    
         
     }     ## end condition
  }        ## end if() RTI transformation
      
      # create object in the environment
      assign(name, 
             final_value, 
             envir = .GlobalEnv)
      
    }      ## end function within pwalk()
  )        ## end pwalk()
    
   ## safety code
    
   } else {
     
        warning(paste("The sheet", name_sheet, "don not have the 'name' or 'value' or 'usage' columns. It was jumped."))
   }
 }         ## end function within iwalk()
)          ## end iwalk()



##  every single param loaded in the environment, 
##  ready to fill in the transitions arrays 
```

02.1 General Parameters -----------------------------------------------------

Strategies:

Prevention Strategy 1 - UreaAire: Prueba de Urea en Aire espirado marcado con Carbono 13 a los 30 años 1 vez

Prevention Strategy 2 - Antígenofecal: Estudio de serología + antígeno en heces fecales a los 30 años 1 vez

Prevention Strategy 3 - EDA: EDA para estudio histológico a los 45 años

Prevention Strategy 4 - PSEDA: Pepsinógeno sérico + EDA para estudio histológico en casos positivos a los 40 años

Prevention Strategy 5 - Serología: Serología + antígeno en deposiciones

Describe states:

Normalhpn = Normal mucosa HelicobacterPilory Negative. Normalhpp = Normal mucosa Helicobacter Pilory Positive. Gastritishpn = Gastritis Helicobacter Pilory Negative. Gastritishpp = Gastritis Helicobacter Pilory Positive. Atrophyhpn = Atrophy Helicobacter Pilory Negative. Atrophyhpp = Atrophy Gastritis Helicobacter Pilory Positive. Intestinalhpn= Intestinal Metaplasia Helicobacter Pilory Negative. Intestinalhpp = Intestinal Metaplasia Helicobacter Pilory Positive. Dysplasiahpn= Dysplasia Helicobacter Pilory Negative. Dysplasiahpp = Dysplasia Helicobacter Pilory Positive

1 preclinical = Stage 1, preclinical 2 preclinical = Stage 2, preclinical 3 preclinical = Stage 3, preclinical 4 preclinical = Stage 4, preclinical 1 clinical a = Stage 1,

1st year after diagnosis 1 clinical b = Stage 1, 2 years after diagnosis 1 clinical c = Stage 1, 3 years after diagnosis 1 clinical d = Stage 1, 4 years after diagnosis 1 clinical e = Stage 1, 5 years after diagnosis 1 clinical f = Stage 1, more than 6 years after diagnosis 2 clinical a = Stage 2,

1st year after diagnosis 2 clinical b = Stage 2, 2 years after diagnosis 2 clinical c = Stage 2, 3 years after diagnosis 2 clinical d = Stage 2, 4 years after diagnosis 2 clinical e = Stage 2, 5 years after diagnosis 2 clinical f = Stage 2, more than 6 years after diagnosis 3 clinical a = Stage 3,

1st year after diagnosis 3 clinical b = Stage 3, 2 years after diagnosis 3 clinical c = Stage 3, 3 years after diagnosis 3 clinical d = Stage 3, 4 years after diagnosis 3 clinical e = Stage 3, 5 years after diagnosis 3 clinical f = Stage 3, more than 6 years after diagnosis 4 clinical a = Stage 4,

1st year after diagnosis 4 clinical b = Stage 4, 2 years after diagnosis 4 clinical c = Stage 4, 3 years after diagnosis 4 clinical d = Stage 4, 4 years after diagnosis 4 clinical e = Stage 4, 5 years after diagnosis 4 clinical f = Stage 4,

more than 6 years after diagnosis Death = Death

## 02.2 Probabilities of death -----------------------------------------------

#### General death probabilities

```{r}
#| eval: true


##---------- Load hazards from the relative survival analysis ----------##

## hojas seleccionadas del excel con los hazards
hazard_sheets_1 <- as.vector(t(outer(1:4,   ## creacion vector de nombres traspuesto del 1:4,  
                             letters[1:6],  ## con las letras a:f
                             paste0)))

## lista de hazards: 
## con map() se toma la lista de nombres y para cada uno 
## se busca en SRfinal.xlsx y guarda la tabla resultante en una lista ordenada.

# map(.x       = lista,
#     .f       = función especificando que hacer,
#     ...      = argumento adicionales,
#     progress = mostrar progreso )

## carga de los hazards
hazard_list_1 <- set_names(hazard_sheets_1) %>%   ## objeto hazard_list que tiene el vector de nombres
  purrr::map(~ read_excel("SRfinal.xlsx",         ## pasar lista nombres a purrr, y aplicar la función a cada elemento
                         sheet = .x,              ## tomar cada hoja del vector y repetir
                         range = "A1:B72")        ## de cada hoja tomar entre las siguientes celdas
)



##---------- Extract age-specific all-cause mortality for ages in model time horizon ----------##

## Filtar lista de hazard según las edades del modelo
## dejando solo las columna H (hazard) y conviertiendo en una matriz

v_r_sr_by_age_list_1 <- hazard_list_1 %>%       ## tomar lista con los hazard
  purrr::map( ~ .x %>%                          ## iterar lo siguiente en cada elemento de hazard_list
    dplyr::filter(Age >= age &                  ## filtar por edades
                    Age < max.age) %>% 
    dplyr::select(H) %>%                        ## seleccionar H (Exceso de hazard)
    as.matrix()                                 ## dejar resultados como una matriz dentro de la lista
            )



##---------- Load life table mortality rates from `.xlsx` format ----------##

LifeTable_Chile <- read_excel("LifeTable_Chile.xlsx") ## cargar tabla de vida



##---------- Extract age-specific relative survival ----------##

## filtar tabla de vida con las edades del modelo y seleccionar columna TotPop (tasa de mortalidad)
v_r_mort_by_age <- LifeTable_Chile %>%
  dplyr::filter(Age >= age & Age < max.age) %>%
  dplyr::select(TotPop) %>%
  as.matrix()



##---------- Age-specific mortality rate in the Healthy state (background mortality) for all cycles ----------##

## calculo mortalidad general según ciclos por año
v_r_HDage <-  rep(v_r_mort_by_age, 
                  each = 1/cycle_length)

## calculo mortalidad específica según ciclos por año
v_r_Dage_list_1 <- map(
  v_r_sr_by_age_list_1, ~          ## a cada matriz de la lista  
    rep(.x,                        ## tomar un elemento y aplicar la funcion rep()
        each = 1/cycle_length)
)
## el resultado es un vector de tamaño n.t (número de ciclos)



##---------- Transform to age-specific background mortality risk for all cycles adjusting by cycle length ----------##

## transformación tasa mortalidad general -> exponencial: p = 1-exp(-rt) -> a probabilidad de morir
v_p_HDage <- 1 - exp(-v_r_HDage * cycle_length)

## transformación mortalidad específica -> suma de riesgos: prob de morir general + prob de muerte por cg
v_r_p_Dage_list_1 <- v_r_Dage_list_1 %>%                       ## tomar la lista de 24 matrices previas
  map(~ v_p_HDage + (1 - exp(-(.x * hr_s1) * cycle_length))    ## transformacion de cada tasa .x de la matrix
)
```

## 02.3 Assign Probabilities vectors of dying in states calculated in 02.2

```{r}
#| eval: true


## cargar en el environment los estadios benignos (las v_p_HDage)

## variables de estadios benignos a muerte.
vars_benign <- c("p.NnD", "p.NpD", "p.GnD", "p.GpD", "p.AnD", 
                 "p.ApD", "p.InD", "p.IpD", "p.DnD", "p.DpD")

# walk( .x   = lista o vector de elmentos,
#       .f   = función a ejecutar, 
#      ...   = argumentos adicionales para la función,
#  .progress = FALSE )


## Asignación de nombres
purrr:: walk(vars_benign,                   ## vector de nombres
             ~ assign(.x,                   ## assign(), asignar a cada elemento del vector
                      v_p_HDage,            ## el valor a asignar
                      envir = .GlobalEnv))  ## y lo envia al environment


############################################################
## variables de estadios con cáncer (probs en la lista v_r_p_Dage_list)

# iwalk( .x  = lista o vector de elementos y entrega: lo que contiene cada elemento; su nombre (en ese orden)
#        .f  = funcion a ejecutar,
#        ... = argumento adicionales  )


## recorrer la lista v_r_p_Dage_list
purrr::iwalk(
  v_r_p_Dage_list_1,                          ## recorrer esta lista de vectores -> es la lista con la suma de probs de muerte 1a-4f
  
  ## función a ejecutar:
  function(vector_prob,                       ## vector_prob  : cada lista interna (vector_prob)
           nombre_código){                    ## nombre_codigo: nombre de cada lista tomada
    
    
    ## escoger número y letra
    estadio  <- substr(nombre_código, 1, 1)   ## estadio: extraer primer caracter del nombre_código
    letra    <- substr(nombre_código, 2, 2)   ## letra: extraer segundo caracter del nombre_código
    
    
    ##  Parte 1: códigos tipo p.1caD (estadios clínicos)
    nombre_clinico <- paste0("p.", estadio, "c", letra, "D") ## pegar "p.", estadio, "c", letra, "D"
    assign(nombre_clinico, vector_prob, envir = .GlobalEnv)  ## asignar el vector de probabilidades y enviar al environment
    
    
    ## Parte 2: códigos tipo: p.1pD (estadios preclínicos)
    if(letra == "a") {                                            ## condición, si letra es "a"
      nombre_preclinico <- paste0("p.", estadio, "pD")            ## pegar: "p.", estadio, "pD"
      assign(nombre_preclinico, vector_prob, envir = .GlobalEnv)  ## asignar el vector de probabilidades y enviar al environment
    } ## fin del if
  }   ## fin de function
)     ## fin de iwalk
```

#### Probability to die from 18 to 29

```{r}
#| label: ingresar ciclos faltantes dado que el modelo se inicia a los 18 años 


# 1. Extraer la mortalidad de la tabla de vida para el burn-in (18-29 años)
v_mort_burn_in <- LifeTable_Chile %>%
  dplyr::filter(Age >= 18 & Age < 30) %>%
  dplyr::select(TotPop) %>%
  as.matrix()


# 2. Transformar a probabilidad
v_p_HDage_burn_in <- 1 - exp(-v_mort_burn_in * cycle_length)


# 3. Identificar SOLO los vectores base (Terminan en D, sin números al final)
## Uso de expresión regular estricta: 
## empieza con p., sigue cualquier cosa (alfanumerica), termina en D.
## vectores_base_nombres <- grep("^p\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+D$", ls(), value = TRUE)
vectores_base_nombres <- c(
  
  ## benignos: solo mortalidad de base (v_p_HDage)
  "p.NnD", "p.NpD", "p.GnD", "p.GpD", "p.AnD",
  "p.ApD", "p.InD", "p.IpD", "p.DnD", "p.DpD",
  
  ## preclínicos: base + exceso del año 1 (hoja Xa de SRfinal.xlsx)
  "p.1pD", "p.2pD", "p.3pD", "p.4pD",
  
  ## clínicos estadio 1: base + exceso hojas 1a:1f
  "p.1caD", "p.1cbD", "p.1ccD", "p.1cdD", "p.1ceD", "p.1cfD",
  
  ## clínicos estadio 2: base + exceso hojas 2a:2f
  "p.2caD", "p.2cbD", "p.2ccD", "p.2cdD", "p.2ceD", "p.2cfD",
  
  ## clínicos estadio 3: base + exceso hojas 3a:3f
  "p.3caD", "p.3cbD", "p.3ccD", "p.3cdD", "p.3ceD", "p.3cfD",
  
  ## clínicos estadio 4: base + exceso hojas 4a:4f
  "p.4caD", "p.4cbD", "p.4ccD", "p.4cdD", "p.4ceD", "p.4cfD"
)


# 4. Inyectar los 12 ciclos iniciales
for (nombre in vectores_base_nombres) {
  
  vector_viejo <- get(nombre, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  ## riesgo base (18-29) + riesgo calculado (30-99)
  vector_nuevo <- c(v_p_HDage_burn_in, vector_viejo)
  
  assign(nombre, vector_nuevo, envir = .GlobalEnv)

} ## fin del for

vectores_base_nombres
length(vectores_base_nombres)

stopifnot(all(sapply(mget(vectores_base_nombres, 
                          envir = .GlobalEnv),
                     length) == n.t))

## detener el código si no todos los vectores de probabilidades de muertes tienen un largo de 82 (ciclos)
stopifnot(all(sapply(mget(vectores_base_nombres, envir = .GlobalEnv),
                     length) == n.t))
```

```{r}
#| eval: true


## cargar en la memoria los estadios benignos (las v_p_HDage)

## variables de estadios benignos
vars_benign_2 <- c("p.NnD31", "p.NpD31", "p.GnD31", "p.GpD31", "p.AnD31", 
                 "p.ApD31", "p.InD31", "p.IpD31", "p.DnD31", "p.DpD31")

## Asignación de nombre
purrr:: walk(vars_benign_2, ~ assign(.x, 
                                   v_p_HDage_2, 
                                   envir = .GlobalEnv))

############################################################
## variables de estadios con cáncer (probs en la lista v_r_p_Dage_list_2)

## recorrer la lista v_r_p_Dage_list_2
purrr::iwalk(
  v_r_p_Dage_list_2, ## recorrer esta lista
  
  ## en cada recorrido hacer:
  function(vector_prob, 
           nombre_código){  
    
    estadio  <- substr(nombre_código, 1, 1)
    letra    <- substr(nombre_código, 2, 2)
    
    nombre_clinico <- paste0("p.", estadio, "c", letra, "D31")
    assign(nombre_clinico, vector_prob, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    
    if(letra == "a") {
      nombre_preclinico <- paste0("p.", estadio, "pD31")
      assign(nombre_preclinico, vector_prob, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }
)
```
